Pushes come from IF/IFNOT (11107), CASE (11181), CASE_FAST (11316), REPEAT (11588) and LOOKUP/LOOKDOWN (14078); compile_top_block (11006) resets the pointer without a push, so the method body is not counted. 17 nested REPEAT = PNut limit + 1.
